title: Plan evaluation result
description: What a phase 2 evaluator returns and writes to <plan>/eval-<area>.json (first evaluation) or eval-<area>-r2.json (the confirming evaluation), beside its report eval-<area>[-r<round>].md (process/03-plan.md, steps 4 and 6). tools/swarm.py checks the returned object, and tools/plan-collate.py checks each must-fix item of the file, with this schema. Each must-fix item is one change to one file of the plan, addressed like a request between parts.

error_rate.description: Items that are `needs change` or `wrong`, over items checked: a fraction between 0 and 1.

by_kind.description: Error rate per kind of item checked, as fractions: contract, file, reader, verdict, rule.

classes.description: The error classes behind the items that are `needs change` or `wrong`: one entry per cause that recurs beyond the sample. The fix round sweeps each class over every sheet and part; after the confirming evaluation, the lead reads the sheets of an area above plan.max_error_rate for each of its classes.

name.description: A short name for the class.

kind.description: The kind of item the class is found in.

pattern.description: What the error looks like, in one or two sentences.

find.description: How to find every instance outside the sample: a grep over the sheets or the code, or the check to run on each row.

to.description: Who changes the plan: the set id whose sheet changes, `contract <id>` for a contract row, or `unowned` for a file no set owns.

path.description: The file of the code the item is about, relative to its repo; empty for a contract row with no file.

kind.description: The kind of item that is wrong: a contract row, a file action, a reader row, a test verdict, a rule break.

what.description: The change to make to the plan, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: path:line at the plan base (or a grep command and its result) that shows the item is wrong.
